【Universal Content Formula】Role + Platform + Format + Audience + Goal + Style

Example: Tech reviewer | YouTube Shorts | 60-second review | Beginners | Drive clicks | Casual, enthusiastic

【TikTok Viral Script - 60 Seconds】You're a TikTok creator with a relatable, energetic tone. Topic:【】, Niche:【Beauty/Fitness/DIY/Finance/Tech】. Write a 60-second talking head script. Structure: 0-3s HOOK (shock/question/counterintuitive) → 3-45s 3 VALUE POINTS (short sentences!) → 45-60s CTA (like/comment/follow). Use emojis in text overlay.
【TikTok Hook Generator】Give me 10 viral hooks for【topic】. Each hook must STOP the scroll - use questions, shock value, or curiosity gaps. Example: "I wasted $1000 on this so you don't have to..."

【YouTube Video Script - 5-10 mins】You're a YouTube content creator. Topic:【】, Target Audience:【】. Write full script with: Hook (first 10s!) → Intro → 5-7 main points (each with example/story) → Common mistakes to avoid → Summary + CTA (like/subscribe/comment). Keep energy high, conversational tone.

【YouTube Thumbnail & Title】Create 5 click-worthy thumbnail ideas + titles for video about【topic】. Titles need: Number/List + Benefit + Curiosity. Thumbnails: Bold text overlay, expressive face/emoji, contrasting colors.

【Instagram Caption - Feed Post】You're an Instagram influencer with authentic voice. Photo/Reel topic:【】, Aesthetic:【Cozy/Minimal/Vibrant/Edgy】. Write caption: Hook (relatable statement) → Story/value → Call-to-action (save/share/comment "YES"). Add 5-10 relevant hashtags.
【Instagram Carousel Post】Create a 5-slide carousel script for【topic】. Each slide: Clear headline + 1 key point + visual suggestion. End with value-packed takeaway and CTA.

【Twitter/X Thread】Write a 10-tweet thread about【topic】. Thread structure: Hook tweet (start with "Thread: " or 🧵) → Problem/observation → 7-8 value points (one per tweet) → Contrarian take → Final summary + CTA (follow/reply). Keep each tweet under 280 chars, use emojis.

【Twitter/X Viral Tweet】Give me 10 viral tweet ideas for【topic/niche】. Each tweet should: Be opinionated/controversial OR super helpful, Use emojis, Ask a question or make a bold claim. Example formats: "Hot take:", "3 things I wish I knew before...", "Most people get this wrong:"

【LinkedIn Professional Post】You're a【job title/industry】expert. Topic:【】. Write a LinkedIn post: Hook (start with data/question/controversy) → Share 3 key insights from experience → Personal story/example → What you learned → Tag relevant people/companies. Professional but conversational.

【Facebook Engagement Post】Write a Facebook post for【topic/community】that sparks comments. Use: Relatable question + shareable opinion + emotional trigger. Add poll/story prompt. Keep it conversational, not too formal.

【Email Newsletter】Write a newsletter for【topic/niche】subscribers. Subject line: Curiosity gap + benefit. Body: Personal opening → 3 value sections (tips/news/resources) → Personal update → CTA (reply/click/read more). Friendly, not salesy.

【Product Review Script】Review【product/service】for social media. Tone: Authentic, trustworthy. Structure: Opening (why I tried it) → Pros (3 specific points) → Cons (1-2 honest drawbacks) → Who should buy it → Final recommendation + affiliate link disclaimer.
【Viral Quote Generator】Create 20 shareable quotes for【theme】. Each quote: Short (1-2 lines), memorable, relatable, suitable for graphics. Example: "The best investment you can make is in yourself."

【Content Idea Brainstorm】I'm a【niche】content creator targeting【audience】. Generate 20 viral content ideas that mix: Educational value, Entertainment, Controversy, Relatability. Format: Platform + Idea + Why it works.

【High-Converting CTA Generator】Write 10 different CTAs for【content type/product】. Use urgency, scarcity, curiosity, or reciprocity. Mix formats: Questions, commands, benefits. Example: "Save this post - you'll thank me later! 💾"
【Comment Engagement Scripts】Write 5 high-engagement comments for【content topic】that spark replies. Use: Personal stories, contrarian views, thought-provoking questions, or helpful additions.
【Reel Transition Script】Create a 15-second Instagram/TikTok transition video concept for【topic】. Include: Opening shot → Transition effect → Reveal → Quick value point → End screen with text overlay.

【Behind-the-Scenes Content】Write a BTS social post for【brand/creator】. Show authenticity: Share struggles, mistakes, or process. Structure: Relatable opening → What you're working on → Challenge you faced → What you learned → CTA to follow along.
【Trendjacking Post】Write a post jumping on【trend/challenge】for【niche】. Connect the trend to your audience's interests. Add your unique twist. Include relevant hashtags and @mentions.
